title: CY49011: Advanced Organic Chemistry Laboratory
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Preparation of o-iodobenzoic acid from anthranilic acid; furoic acid from
furfural; thiamine catalysed benzoin condensation; preparation of benzil from
benzoin; benzilic acid from benzil; and their characterization by UV, IR and
NMR; other related experiments.
